denominator_rule: adjacent complete-month pairs where both months have one unique positive event-count maximum; ambiguous or empty months break the sequence
confounders: event volume is not authority or intent
primary actor changes are activity-derived and distinct from declared handovers
status_note: published by rh_cli succession only when an explicit complete-month actor event-count matrix is supplied; ties and empty months break adjacent comparisons and actor indexes are omitted from the result
